subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should OpenClaw publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook before the generated-wrapper and doctor/install fixes are implemented?
rationale: The PR is docs-only and technically coherent, but it recommends operator launchd mutations that can affect node-service availability; that tradeoff needs maintainer intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning and keep runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

options.title: Hold For Runtime Fix
options.body: Defer the docs until wrapper generation or doctor/install repair lands so users are not asked to carry a manual launchd workaround.

options.title: Require Narrower Operator Wording
options.body: Ask for maintainer-specific prerequisites or safer wording around when node LaunchAgent disablement is acceptable before merge.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning and keep runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the docs, launchd, service-env, and supervisor-marker surfaces involved in the product choice.
